1. 이단의 분별\n- 가만히 들어온 사람 몇이 속을 썩임.\n=> 그런:
1. Discerning heresy
- A few people who crept in unnoticed are causing grief.
=> Guys like that were already marked out long ago for condemnation. People who deny Jesus Christ.
- Guys like that are hidden rocks in your love feasts (like biting down on a stone)
바람에 불려가는 물 없는 구름: Clouds without water, carried along by the winds
열매 없는 가을 나무다.\n- 특징 -> 원망하는 자, 불만을 토로하는:
Autumn trees without fruit.
- Traits -> grumblers, complainers, people who walk after their own lusts, who speak boastful words, and flatter people for gain
- Exhortation -> build yourselves up on your faith, pray in the Holy Spirit, keep yourselves in the love of God, and wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life. Have mercy on some who doubt.
